diagnostics: The first remote launch used POSIX environment assignment under csh and failed before any Spectre STARTED marker. Corrected to env; exactly 16 Spectre attempts followed.

A development attempt rejected every sample inside an uncertain delayed activation interval and caused an existing short-pulse regression. Final code encloses held/activated possibilities, keeps original tolerances and all existing regressions pass.
limits: History certification is conditional on compiled binary64 IR, fixed actual accepted source-event times and sampled drives; it is not a bound relative to ideal nominal timer/cross times, frontend rounding, PWL evaluation or physical model error.
Accepted computation points only, not a continuous-time qualification or unseen confirmation set. Interval dependency can cause conservative rejection; no automatic higher-precision fallback.
Spectre comparison has its separately frozen conditional waveform allowance; it is not a proof of the EVAS internal precision certificate.
No new original 31-condition matrix, no cross-backend performance ranking, no new Gnucap/OpenVAF execution.

archive.selection: All run files except generated *.ahdlSimDB directories, *.so and AppleDouble ._* metadata; all retrieved files verified against full remote manifest. Raw data not publicly archived.
